package http

import (
	"encoding/json"
	stdhttp "net/http"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"

	adminv1 "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1"
	adminhandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	adminmw "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/middleware"
	apiv1 "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	apihandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	apimw "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	telegramtransport "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/integrations/telegram"
	privatehttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private"
	privatehandlers "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
)

// RouterDependencies contains handlers for each independent HTTP contour.
type RouterDependencies struct {
	APIPersonalTeacher   *apihandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler
	APITeacherDialog     *apihandlers.TeacherDialogHandler
	APICurriculum        *apihandlers.CurriculumHandler
	APILearningSession   *apihandlers.LearningSessionHandler
	APITelegram          *apihandlers.TelegramChannelHandler
	APIOnboarding        *apihandlers.TeacherOnboardingHandler
	APINextBestAction    *apihandlers.NextBestActionHandler
	AdminPersonalTeacher *adminhandlers.PersonalTeacherHandler
	PrivateHealth        *privatehandlers.HealthHandler
	InternalToken        string
	TelegramWebhook      *telegramtransport.Handler
}

// NewRouter composes public, administrative, and private routes.
func NewRouter(dependencies RouterDependencies) stdhttp.Handler {
	root := chi.NewRouter()

	api := apiv1.NewRouter(dependencies.APIPersonalTeacher, dependencies.APITeacherDialog, dependencies.APICurriculum, dependencies.APILearningSession, dependencies.APITelegram, dependencies.APIOnboarding, dependencies.APINextBestAction)
	authenticatedAPI := chi.NewRouter()
	authenticatedAPI.Use(apimw.AuthMiddleware)
	authenticatedAPI.Mount("/", api)
	root.Mount("/api/v1", authenticatedAPI)

	admin := adminv1.NewRouter(dependencies.AdminPersonalTeacher)
	authenticatedAdmin := chi.NewRouter()
	authenticatedAdmin.Use(adminmw.AuthMiddleware)
	authenticatedAdmin.Mount("/", admin)
	root.Mount("/admin/v1", authenticatedAdmin)
	if dependencies.TelegramWebhook != nil {
		root.Mount("/integrations/telegram/webhook", dependencies.TelegramWebhook)
	}

	if dependencies.InternalToken != "" {
		root.Mount("/internal", privatehttp.NewRouter(dependencies.PrivateHealth, dependencies.InternalToken))
	}
	root.NotFound(func(w stdhttp.ResponseWriter, _ *stdhttp.Request) {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(stdhttp.StatusNotFound)
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"error": "not found"})
	})
	return root
}
